title: Muxed address from ID 2^64 (one past the uint64 range) must be refused
why: MuxedAccount.med25519.id is a uint64; a builder that accepts a value no uint64 equals encodes some other ID, and the muxed address then routes to a different sub-account than the caller meant.

known_divergences.detail: MuxedAccount packs the ID modulo 2^64: 2^64 is encoded as muxed ID 0, a different sub-account.

notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/cap-0027/api-muxed-account-id-encoding.id-2-pow-64.json. Origin: probe vector 2m3 (passed as a big integer here), in evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json, executed in every probe column (evidence/sdk-matrix). 2^64 does not fit a uint64. A builder that truncates encodes ID 0. Passed as a big integer, so an SDK whose parameter is a fixed 64-bit type answers n_a (value_not_representable). Expected values were computed from the XDR definitions, the CAP or SEP text and the stellar-core rule cited under related, with an independent encoder; no SDK output was used.
